# Agentic Insights 0.2.0

This release adds richer local insight into coding-agent usage and refreshes the pricing catalog used to estimate the impact of model activity.

- adds prompt previews, spend trends, and highest-spend session rankings
- fixes pricing for recent OpenAI usage in impact charts
- refreshes the bundled Portkey MIT pricing catalog with current model data
- updates development dependencies to resolve the esbuild security advisory
